topic.label: Robotics
topic.desc: Robotics: kinematics and dynamics, perception, motion planning and navigation, control, manipulation, robot software (ROS), simulation, and safety and human-robot interaction. Ontology: Robotics is its own topic; Drones are aerial robots, and Mapping holds SLAM, which robots use for navigation.

concepts.label: Control
concepts.desc: Feedback control of robot joints and vehicles: PID, state-space and model-predictive control.

concepts.label: Kinematics and Dynamics
concepts.desc: Robot geometry and motion: joints, frames, Jacobians and equations of motion.

concepts.label: Manipulation and Grasping
concepts.desc: Picking, placing and handling objects with arms and grippers.

concepts.label: Perception
concepts.desc: Sensing and estimating the world: sensor fusion, detection and pose estimation.

concepts.label: Motion Planning and Navigation
concepts.desc: Finding collision-free paths and trajectories and navigating to goals.

concepts.label: Safety and Human-Robot Interaction
concepts.desc: Safe operation near people, safety cases and interaction design.

concepts.label: Robot Simulation and Sim-to-Real
concepts.desc: Physics simulation of robots and the gap between simulation and reality.

concepts.label: Robot Software and ROS
concepts.desc: Robot middleware: nodes, topics, services, actions and bridges to AI models.

skills.label: Actuator and Motor Driver Selector
skills.desc: Selects motors, drivers and gearing for torque, speed and duty cycle and checks thermal limits.

skills.label: PID Tuner
skills.desc: Tunes PID gains from step responses and reports overshoot, settling time and stability margin.

skills.label: State-Space and Predictive Controller
skills.desc: Designs LQR or model-predictive controllers from a linear model and checks constraint handling.

skills.label: Dynamics Modeler
skills.desc: Builds equations of motion with Lagrangian or Newton-Euler methods and identifies inertial parameters.

skills.label: Forward and Inverse Kinematics
skills.desc: Computes end-effector pose from joint angles and the reverse, and reports singularities and multiple solutions.

skills.label: Gripper and End-Effector Selector
skills.desc: Chooses a gripper type for the objects and forces involved and lists payload and compliance limits.

skills.label: Grasp Planner
skills.desc: Plans grasps from object shape and gripper geometry and ranks them by stability and reachability.

skills.label: Depth and 3D Perception
skills.desc: Builds depth maps and point clouds from stereo, time-of-flight or LiDAR sensors and filters noise.

skills.label: Object Detection and Pose Estimation
skills.desc: Detects objects and estimates their six-degree-of-freedom pose for grasping or avoidance and reports failure cases.

skills.label: Sensor Fusion Engineer
skills.desc: Fuses IMU, wheel, camera and LiDAR data with Kalman-type filters and reports the estimate's uncertainty.

skills.label: Navigation Stack Integrator
skills.desc: Configures localization, costmaps and a local planner for a mobile robot and tests recovery behaviours.

skills.label: Path Planner
skills.desc: Plans collision-free paths with graph search and sampling-based planners and compares their completeness and cost.

skills.label: Trajectory Optimizer
skills.desc: Turns a path into a smooth, time-parameterized trajectory within velocity, acceleration and torque limits.

skills.label: Human-Robot Interaction Designer
skills.desc: Designs how a robot signals intent and responds to people nearby, with speed and separation rules.

skills.label: Safety Case Assessor
skills.desc: Drafts a hazard analysis and safety argument for a robot cell or mobile robot and lists which standards a qualified assessor must check.

skills.label: Sim-to-Real Validator
skills.desc: Compares simulated and real robot behaviour and lists the parameters that explain the gap.

skills.label: Simulation Builder
skills.desc: Builds a physics simulation of a robot and its world with sensor models and repeatable test scenarios.

skills.label: Launch and Config Debugger
skills.desc: Debugs launch files, parameters and transforms and explains why a node does not start or communicate.

skills.label: ROS Bridge Integrator
skills.desc: Connects an AI model to a ROS robot through a bridge, restricts which topics and services it may use and keeps a human stop in the loop.

skills.label: ROS Node Developer
skills.desc: Writes ROS nodes with topics, services and actions and tests message types and timing.
